packageRules.description: 1.17+ ships an OTP point release that surfaces a deprecated-catch warning rebar3 escalates to an error inside the jose Erlang lib. Unpin once jose >1.11.12 ships a fix.

Runtime erlang must match the OTP version bundled in the gleam build image. minimumGroupSize=2 postpones branch creation until both have a pending update so they bump as one PR — never bumping erlang alone.
